_comment: repositoryUrl is pinned rather than inferred from the git origin because it
has to match the feed VelopackUpdateService reads (InfoViewModel.ProjectUrl).
If the two ever disagree, releases publish to one repository and every
installed copy checks the other - and the only symptom is that updates
silently never arrive. ReleaseConfigTests asserts they are equal.
_comment_packaging: There is no prepare step and no @semantic-release/exec. Packing used to happen
here, which meant the release job both packed - signing as this project - and
ran an npx dependency tree of hundreds of packages on the same runner. Both
installers are now built and signed on runners of their own in release.yml, and
this configuration only tags and uploads what those jobs produced. See the
comment at the top of release.yml.
